question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Ponderous
solution:
The correct answer is option no.(2) i.e. **'Graceful'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Ponderous** means slow and clumsy because of great weight.**(नीरस/भददा)**

 
 
• **Example:-** He spoke in **ponderous** voice.
 
 
 
• The word **Graceful **means having or showing grace or elegance.**(मनोहर)**
 
 
• **Example:-** she was a tall girl, slender and** graceful.**
 
 
 
• As both the words Ponderous and Graceful are opposite in meaning.

Therefore,the correct option is no.**(2)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other options are:
 
 
• **Obligated- **require or compel (someone) to undertake a legal or moral duty.**(नैतिक कर्तव्य से बाध्य)**
 
• **Swollen- **become larger or rounder in size, typically as a result of an accumulation of fluid.**(फुला हुआ)**
 
• **Adverse- **preventing success or development; harmful.**(प्रतिकुल)**
